verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekasaddampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, purisasaddo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single sound that occupies a woman’s mind like the sound of a man.

verses.pali: Purisasaddo, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The sound of a man occupies a woman’s mind.”
